summary: Backend-only testing for new Camp + decimal Fatigue features in LOTR 5e travel system. All 16 pytest tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: camp_journey endpoint relies only on fatiga_cd_decrement and never touches characters' fatiga. As documented, character fatigue changes are client-driven - main agent should ensure frontend CampDialog.jsx actually invokes PUT /api/characters/{id}/fatigue per member (auto -1 + CON save) otherwise accumulated fatigue won't be applied.
No validation on CampRequest.fatiga_cd_decrement: a negative decrement would increase the DC (still clamped at max 10 floor but could exceed original). Consider clamping to >=0.
ActiveJourney.fatiga_cd_total default 10.0; old journeys created before this change may have int values (e.g. 11). float() cast in camp_journey handles this safely.
character fatigue PUT endpoint: correct float handling, clamps 0-6 and rounds to 0.5 increments as per spec.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed character and active_journey docs directly in MongoDB and clean them up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file backend/tests/test_camp_fatigue.py covers: PUT /api/characters/{id}/fatigue (decimal/clamp/round), POST /api/travel/journey/{id}/camp (decrement, floor at 10, custom decrement, preserves fields, 404), GET /api/travel/config/events, and ActiveJourney fatiga_cd_total float handling. Uses MongoClient directly for fixtures to avoid the 9-step wizard and journey start complexities.
